RuleCondition.title: RuleCondition
RuleCondition.description:
Single condition in a rule's conditions array.

Validates field name pattern to prevent injection attacks.
Field must start with letter, contain only alphanumeric + underscore.

Examples:
    >>> RuleCondition(field="documentType", value="invoice")
    RuleCondition(field='documentType', value='invoice')

    >>> RuleCondition(field="123invalid", value="test")  # doctest: +SKIP
    ValidationError: field must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$

RuleInput.title: RuleInput
RuleInput.description:
Request model for creating a rule.

Validates rule structure with exactly 1 condition (for CIN-12944).
Future stories can expand to multiple conditions (AND logic).

Unknown fields are rejected at every level of the body: at the root by
``extra="forbid"``, inside ``conditions`` by ``StrictRuleCondition``, and inside
``config`` by ``get_validated_config`` (CIN-14209).

jobId.title: Jobid
jobId.description: Unique identifier of the job being queried

startedAt.title: Startedat
startedAt.description: When the workflow run started (ISO-8601, UTC with an offset). Present once a run has started.

updatedAt.title: Updatedat
updatedAt.description: When the workflow run last changed (ISO-8601, UTC with an offset). Equals the completion time once the run has finished.

fileType.title: Filetype
fileType.description: The detected file type (e.g., 'application/pdf'), or 'empty' for a zero-byte file. Present after the run finishes, when a type was detected.

fileSize.title: Filesize
fileSize.description: Size in bytes of the file as inspected (0 for an empty file; the downscaled size for a large image). Present after the run finishes, when it is known.

page_count.title: Page Count
page_count.description: The number of pages in the document. Present after the run finishes, when pages were counted.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: The attempt count the workflow recorded for the file-type stage: 1 when the stage returned a result (even after retries), 5 when the retries ran out, 0 when the stage was never called. It is not the number of HTTP calls. Present after the run finishes.

errorClassification.title: Errorclassification
errorClassification.description: Whether the failure is 'permanent' (retrying will not help) or 'transient'. Present when the job status is 'Error'.

errorMessage.title: Errormessage
errorMessage.description: Why the job failed, in words safe to show to a client. Present when the job status is 'Error'.

strategy.title: Chunking Strategy
strategy.description: Strategy used to split the document into chunks. `fixed` produces fixed-size chunks with a configurable `chunk_overlap`; `context` splits along semantic/structural boundaries (headings, tables) and ignores `chunk_overlap`. Defaults to `fixed`.

chunk_size.title: Chunk Size
chunk_size.description: Target size, in characters, for each chunk. Must be greater than 512. When embeddings are enabled the value is clamped to the embedding model's maximum chunk size. Defaults to 2000.

chunk_overlap.title: Chunk Overlap
chunk_overlap.description: Number of overlapping characters between consecutive chunks. Only applies to the `fixed` chunking strategy and is ignored for `context` chunking. Defaults to 100 when omitted. The value is always clamped so that `chunk_overlap <= chunk_size / 2`. Out-of-range values are reduced and the adjustment is reported in the response message.

location_reporting.title: Location Reporting
location_reporting.description: Controls how source locations are reported for each chunk. `merged` reports a single bounding box covering the largest page the chunk spans; `single` reports the chunk's first location marker. Defaults to `merged`.

model.title: Embedding Model
model.description: Identifier of the model used to generate embeddings for each chunk. Must be one of the enabled embedding models; the name is matched case-insensitively and normalized to its canonical form. Defaults to the environment's configured embedding model.

precision.title: Embedding Precision
precision.description: Numeric precision of the generated embedding vectors. `float32` produces full-precision vectors; `int8` produces smaller quantized vectors where the model supports it. The value must be supported by the selected model. Defaults to `float32`.

extract_tables.title: Extract Tables
extract_tables.description: When enabled, detects tables in images and emits them as markdown tables. Enabling this increases processing time. Defaults to false.

ocr_filter_enabled.title: OCR Pre-filtering
ocr_filter_enabled.description: Controls whether OCR pre-filtering runs to skip images unlikely to contain text. Defaults to true.

quotations.title: Normalize Quotations
quotations.description: When enabled, converts typographic (curly) single and double quotation marks to their plain ASCII equivalents. Defaults to false.

dashes.title: Normalize Dashes
dashes.description: When enabled, converts en-dashes and em-dashes to plain ASCII hyphens. Defaults to false.

pii.title: PII
pii.description: Personally identifiable information (PII) detection and redaction. To enable it, send an object with a `mode`, for example `{"mode": "redaction"}`. To disable it, send the JSON boolean `false` (not the string `"false"`). The legacy string form (`"detection"` or `"redaction"`) is still accepted, but use the object form instead.

image_embedding.title: Image Embedding (Alpha)
image_embedding.description: 🚧 **ALPHA** – experimental, subject to change. Generate embeddings for images.

image_embedding_model.title: Image Embedding Model (Alpha)
image_embedding_model.description: 🚧 **ALPHA** – experimental, subject to change. Model to use for image embeddings.

SubmitOptions.title: SubmitOptions
SubmitOptions.description:
Validated user-submitted pipeline options.

Represents the user's input after normalization, legacy key mapping,
and basic type/value validation. Does not include system-only fields
(max_chunk_size or max_chunks_per_request).

Can be used directly as a FastAPI request body model (accepts raw API
input with extra fields) or via ``from_dict()`` for dict-based parsing.

mode.title: PII Mode
mode.description: Controls how detected personally identifiable information (PII) is handled. `detection` reports the PII entities found without altering the text; `redaction` removes or masks the detected entities in the output.

entity_redaction.title: Entity Redaction
entity_redaction.description: When enabled, replaces each redacted PII value with a label identifying its entity type (e.g. `[PERSON]`) instead of a generic mask. Only applies when `mode` is `redaction`. Enabling this increases processing time. Defaults to false.
